name: bar-compliant-marketing-reviewer
description: Bar-Compliant Marketing Reviewer — Claude Desktop plugin. Reviews attorney marketing materials — websites, social posts, ads, email campaigns — against your state bar's advertising rules and flags non-compliant language before it goes live.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version bar-compliant-marketing-reviewer-v$npm_package_version.zip bar-compliant-marketing-reviewer-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
